retrieval_query_used: Severe intermittent right-sided aching pain (8–9/10) involved the right maxillary tooth region with radiation to the orbital, temporal, and infratemporal areas. Attacks lasted from minutes to a couple of hours and occurred 2–12 times daily. Episodes were associated with right eye tearing, facial swelling, increased facial temperature, and inability to focus during attacks, including needing to pull off the road while driving. Pain was not relieved by ibuprofen or acetaminophen and was completely relieved with verapamil.
